question: All the compounds of which of the following sets belongs to the same homologous series?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**C3H8, C4H10, C5H****12**__**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• A **homologous series** is a series of organic compounds which belong to the same family (**i.e.** **possess the same functional group**) and show similar chemical properties.
 
• The members of this series are called homologs and differ from each other by the number of CH₂ units in the main carbon chain.
 
• Alkanes have the general formula of CₙH₂ₙ₊₂ where n is the number of carbon atoms.
 
• C3H8, C4H10, C5H12 are alkanes of the same homologous series they are differed by CH₂ .
